title: Abajulirwa Abazikiridde
intro: Mu mulembe ogw’edda ennyo, ekitundu kyali kibeera mu nkulungo y’ettaka wakati w’obwakabaka. Nabbi waabwe yabayita okugenda mu kkubo ery’amazima, naye ne banywerera ku butakkiriza n’okunyigirizibwa. Emboozi eno ekoma mu kwesasuza okw’obwakatonda. Osobola okuzuula eggwanga lino n’enkomerero yaalyo okusinziira ku bubonero buno wammanga?
clues: Abantu baagaana okulabula okwaleetebwa omu ku babaka baabwe bennyini.
Omubaka yatuyita tusinza Allah yekka n’alabula ku nguzi.
Okusobya kwaffe kwali kugaana nnabbi eyatutumibwa mu ffe n’obutuukirivu.
Twabuusabuusa obuyinza bw’omubaka era ne tumulumiriza obulimba.
Ekibonerezo kyatutuukako nga tusula bulungi mu maka gaffe.
Twasaanawo olw’okwegaana nabbi waffe n’okuyigganya abakkiriza.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Abantu baasenguka ne bagenda mu nsi empya

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
